pr_title: Set `VehiculeWheel3D` `suspension_travel` default value to a reasonable one
pr_body:
Fixes #75059

Sets the `VehiculeWheel3D` `suspension_travel` default value to 0.2 meters. It is currently... 5 meters.

Can be cherry-picked for 4.0.1, I think.
pr_comments: This is technically a compatibility-breaking change, as existing projects that use the default value will have the value changed without notice (even if it's unlikely that any project is using the default value right now). We should find a way to apply it to newly created projects only somehow.
Considering that the default value is useless for most games, I think this is a perfectly acceptable behavior change for 4.1. But I would not cherry-pick to 4.0.x.
Yeah, I agree, we can merge it without worrying much about the compatibility.

issue_context.title: VehicleWheel3D default suspension travel is too high (5 meters)
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0

### System information

Any

### Issue description

This should be changed to something sensible like 0.5, the tooltip also suggests this in 4.0 thankfully but I think 5 entire metres is a bit of a stretch (ha) 

When I was a non-docs-reading noob, this caused me many hours of pain because i put my wheels next to my car expecting them to work but the car would always sink flat into the wheels or too over

### Steps to reproduce

Make a car visually ‘accurate’ with nodes, put the wheels in the right spot, don’t change any settings for anything, and then run the project to see your vehicle sink into the floor.

### Minimal reproduction project

n/a
comments: Thanks for the report, and sorry for your hours of pain. :rofl:

review_comments: Unrelated to this PR, but it's really weird that this isn't in meters like every other value.
